facts.fact: The Herald reports that ZIMSTAT launched a chatbot, alongside a WhatsApp line and a toll-free line, on African Statistics Day so the public can query statistics, verify enumerators and give feedback.

ZWE.note: The article does not say the chatbot uses AI.
No census or census-based survey results stated; the 2023-24 ZDHS figures cited are water and sanitation only, with no publication stated.
ZIMSTAT's chatbot and lines are enquiry and feedback channels, not government transactions.
Nothing on local government office connection.
